code:
.PHONY: help install lint test run clean

help: ## show this help
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*?## ' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | awk -F':.*?## ' '{printf "  %-12s %s\n", $$1, $$2}'

install: ## install deps
	pip install -r requirements.txt

lint: ## run lint
	ruff check .

test: ## run tests
	pytest -q

run: ## run {{project_name}}
	python -m {{project_name}}

clean: ## clean caches
	rm -rf .pytest_cache __pycache__ .ruff_cache
summary_zh: Makefile 自動 help + 標準 target
